Awendaw Friday Social (Beginner) Ride

Awendaw, SC · Road

Beginner friendlyNo-drop

Awendaw Friday Social (Beginner) Ride is a road group ride in Awendaw, SC. It rolls every Friday at 10:00 am from Sewee Outpost. About 32 miles, 15–17 mph. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 10:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 15–17 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Awendaw Friday Social (Beginner) Ride group ride

The beginner-labeled version of the club's Awendaw ride. Thirty-two miles on quiet roads north of Charleston at 15 to 17 mph, no-drop. The A and B groups leave from the same spot at 9 if you want faster.
